mechanism: Posaconazole is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase lisdexamfetamine metabolite (dexamfetamine) exposure, potentially increasing sympathomimetic effects; both drugs may also increase QT interval risk.
action: Monitor for increased amphetamine-related adverse effects (tremor, tachycardia, hypertension, insomnia) and consider ECG monitoring; dose adjustment of lisdexamfetamine may be necessary.
